title: SRFTI students in Kolkata boycott classes and hold sit-in over campus security
seoTitle: Kolkata SRFTI students protest for security

tea.why: Students are protesting against on-campus violence and security lapses following incidents on September 27 and October 4.
tea.want: Students demand better campus security and the resignation of Vice-Chancellor Santosh Ajmera.
tea.changed: Oct 12: Students began an indefinite sit-in outside the vice-chancellor's office to demand his resignation.

summary: Students at the Satyajit Ray Film and Television Institute (SRFTI) in Kolkata have been boycotting classes since September 27, 2026, following a clash during an event hosted by an RSS-affiliated group on campus. Tensions persisted after a second incident on October 4 involving the Bangiya Hindu Jagaran Mancha. The SRFTI students' union, represented by spokesperson Sudip Chakraborty, alleges that the administration has failed to ensure student safety and that some staff members have intimidated protesters. While the institute issued a statement on October 5 condemning the violence and pledging to work with local authorities, students have escalated their action by launching an indefinite sit-in outside the office of Vice-Chancellor Santosh Ajmera. Many students have vacated their hostels ahead of the Durga Puja vacation as the academic boycott continues.
response: The institute stated on October 5 that it is deeply concerned about the incidents, condemns violence and intimidation, and is coordinating with local authorities to maintain peace and security.

injuries.text: Several people were reported injured, including two faculty members, during the September 27 clash.

updates.text: Students begin a class boycott following a clash during an event on campus.
A second incident occurs involving the Bangiya Hindu Jagaran Mancha outside the institute gate.
The institute issues a statement condemning the violence and promising to ensure student safety.
Students begin an indefinite sit-in outside the vice-chancellor's office.
